messages:
sasha: Noticing a new pattern in ap-southeast1: pods go Pending waiting on device attach, then scheduler preempts lower-priority pods to free nodes -> eviction spike (~2x).

blake: Checking node logs: nvlink errors + 'device plugin attach retry' on a subset of racks. Looks like intermittent NVLink fabric flaps causing the device-plugin to retry mounts, which holds the attach lock and trips attach timeout.

rachel: Affected jobs are tiny-gang fractional GPU with strict requiredDuringScheduling affinity and hard anti-affinity. Because some nodes have NVLink islands flaky, the scheduler can't pack tiny-gang and ends up preempting to reclaim whole nodes.

sasha: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) taint the flaky nodes (kubectl taint nodes node-xyz nvlink=flap:NoSchedule) to stop scheduling new tiny-gang there, 2) relax podAntiAffinity to preferred for tiny-gang for 30m so they can colocate on healthy islands, 3) scale warm pool by +1 in region.

blake: I'll run a filter to detect nodes with repeated "nvlink.*error" in last 15m and taint them as quarantine. Command: `kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[?(@.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status=="True")].metadata.name}'` then `kubectl taint node $N nvlink=quarantine:NoSchedule` (will annotate taint reason).

rachel: Can we update scheduler to prefer packing tiny-gang on nodes labeled `nvlink=stable`? Long-term we should avoid mixing uncertain islands with stable ones. I'll open SCHED-900 to add node scoring for NVLink topology.

infra-bot: INC-2026-420 created: "ap-southeast1 nvlink fabric flaps -> device attach retries -> preempt cascade" assigned to eng-platform.

sasha: Action list: blake -> run taint quarantine script and share node list; rachel -> short-lived soft-affinity rollout doc; ops -> prep +1 warm node if eviction rate doesn't drop in 20m. We'll capture fragmentation metric per NVLink-island too.

ops: Standby to bring +1 on-demand GPU node for 8h if impact persists. Note cost vs APAC latency tradeoffs in runbook.

sasha: Rolling now; will post a 10m metric snapshot (attach_latency, preempt_rate, eviction_count).
